text:
amy: Quick sync — proposing a "soft-preemption credit" pilot. Outline: allow reserved tenants to opt into extended drain (3min) + staged throttle before eviction in exchange for lower monthly commit (-15%). Need ops validation, SLO guardrails, and launch criteria.
derek: Can you share concrete numbers? Also how does this interact with autoscale prewarm/backfill behavior?
sofia: Love the idea. Must surface p95/p99 latency, shed events, and backfill cost. Need dashboard + alert thresholds.
jason: Sales interest: 2 enterprise prospects asked for cheaper reserved tiers with softer guarantees. They'll want clear SLA text & risk examples.
amy: Proposal numbers: normal drain = 30s, extended drain = 180s; throttle stages: 1) token-rate -50% for 60s, 2) windowed shed for next 60s, then eviction. Pricing: -15% commit discount or optional burst-credit rollover.
derek: Eng checks: a) can autoscaler accept gradual-shed signals? b) safe KV cache invalidation for 180s drains? c) preemption ordering impact on prioritized pools?
sofia: Telemetry requirements: per-tenant preempt_count, avg_drain_time, p95/p99 gen latency during drain, queued_requests growth, backfill GPUs. Alert if p99 > baseline +20% for >5m.
autoscale-bot: canary adaptive-shed v0.4 on prod-beta yesterday -> shed.events=31, avg_drain=172s, immediate_evictions_down=14%, observed_p99_spike=6-9% on heavy tails. logs: `shed.summary=ok, spillback=3`
jason: Need a one-pager + sample SLA + opt-in language. Legal should vet discounted commit wording.
amy: Pilot decision checklist: 1) 3 low-latency-tolerant tenants enrolled, 2) dashboard + alerting live, 3) ops runbook + kill-switch, 4) rollback gate: auto-disable if p99 > +15% sustained 10m OR eviction_rate > baseline +25%.
derek: Eng estimate: infra telemetry (1 sprint), autoscale signal plumbing (2 sprints), safe-drain + CI tests (1 sprint) = 4 sprints. Need synthetic heavy-tail testing and chaos sims.
sofia: I'll author the runbook PR and dashboard panels. Post-pilot QA: customer feedback, backfill cost reconciliation, churn signal analysis.
amy: Next actions: @derek resource estimate by EOW, @sofia runbook + panels, @jason draft external materials & customer outreach list. I'll schedule a 30m decision sync Tue. :calendar: :memo:

sofia: :thumbsup:
jason: :thumbsup:
amy: If no blockers, we proceed. Add any blockers in thread.
